task: Welcome to another life changing session of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First, it would be great if you could open the chest drawer. And then, recover the old key from the chest drawer. After you have got the old key, make it so that the wooden door within the bedroom is unlocked with the old key. And then, ensure that the wooden door inside the bedroom is open. Then, try to move east. And then, open the refrigerator. Then, retrieve the tomato plant from the refrigerator. And then, rest the tomato plant on the stove. Alright, thanks!
